description: In relay_queue.rs, drain_once reads .env filenames from the directory listing and processes them in filesystem-order (readdir), which is neither FIFO nor deterministic across reboots. On a busy queue this means newer messages can be delivered before older ones, violating FIFO fairness. A large backlog of permanent-failure messages will be retried in random order on each drain cycle. Fix: collect .env files, sort by the embedded timestamp/sequence in the filename (or by mtime), then process in ascending order.
title: smtp: relay_queue drain processes files in non-deterministic order
